Subject: POC Kickoff - Redwood + Acme

Hi Sarah / David,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the context on the search relevance pilot. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- Scope: 2-week POC targeting product search relevance for the web storefront (up to 5M tokens / month simulated).
- Success criteria: +6% click-through on top-3 results (vs baseline) and no more than 1% latency tail increase.
- Technical contacts: Sarah (product), David (infra) — we'll need a short-lived API key and a sample dataset (CSV with product id/title/description).

Proposed next steps: 
1) I’ll drop a lightweight POC checklist and the scoped quote — see attachments.
2) We schedule a 30-min kickoff to walk through onboarding and access (suggesting week of Aug 9).
3) We’ll provision a trial environment and send integration instructions; typical setup time is 1–2 business days if you can share the dataset and a service account.

Attachments: POC-setup-checklist.pdf, redwood-poc-quote.pdf
Drive folder with docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-poc
Calendly (kickoff): https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/30min

If the timing looks good I can schedule the kickoff — what day/time next week works best?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
